label: The Club Wars
summary: Your club at Northgate will be shut down unless it wins the spring showcase, and the rival club has your ex as its president.
title: The Club Wars
description: The student council is cutting clubs. Yours, the Night Owls film society, has six members and a projector held together with tape. Your rival is the polished Northgate Drama Guild, and the one person you never wanted to see again runs it.

chapterOutlines.title: The Council Meeting
chapterOutlines.outline: Hear the news, rally your six members, and run into your ex.

chapterOutlines.title: Rehearsal Week
chapterOutlines.outline: Make a showcase out of nothing while the Guild plays dirty, or doesn’t.

chapterOutlines.title: Showcase Night
chapterOutlines.outline: Put on the show, and settle things with the rival club one way or another.

scene.location: A basement screening room under the Northgate library
scene.summary: Late afternoon. The projector rattles. Five club members look at you after reading the council’s email.

openThreads: Is the Guild really behind the rumors?

npcs.name: Theo Lindqvist
npcs.description: Your ex. Charming in public, surprisingly unsure in private.
goals: Find out if you still hate him

npcs.name: Priya Nair
npcs.description: Third-year engineering student who keeps the projector alive by force of will.
goals: Save the club that saved her first year

relationships.label: Friend
relationships.status: Ready to fight for the club
